text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Tore-san. I can't believe 
you actually got it for me...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Is it really okay for me to have this?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! I'll be sure to tell 
them that you're the one who got it, 
Tore-san!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if those girls will like it... 
Fufu.
